title: An Unexpected Turn of Events
overview: After the events of the last season, Ye Jiayao finally becomes engaged to Xia Chunyu. Unexpectedly, Chamberlain Ping shows up with an Imperial Edict. What does the Emperor want with Yaoyao?

title: His heart!
overview: Yaoyao impresses the Emperor with her cooking at Princess Liuli's birthday banquet. The Emperor sends Chunyu to the Nanyue Kingdom.

title: Soul-Searching Journey!
overview: Yaoyao sets off to Nanyue to meet up with Chunyu. On the way, she meets Jing.

title: Fated Person
overview: Ye Jiayao heads with Jing towards Nanyue to meet Xia Chunyu. Along the way, several refugees from Nanyue begin to appear.

title: Don't Worry! There's Food!
overview: With Ah Ruan as their guide, Yaoyao, Chunyu and Jing set off on their journey to the Nanyue Kingdom.

title: The Trio Who Survive Countless Perils
overview: Yaoyao, Jing and Ah Ruan continue to make their way to the Nanyue Kingdom.

title: Ruan's Home
overview: Yaoyao impresses the king of the Nanyue Kingdom with her cooking skills.

title: Wonderful Date
overview: Yaoyao, Jing and Ah Ruan begin their journey back to Jinling.

title: The Happy Emperor
overview: Yaoyao impresses the Emperor with her cooking inspired by the journey to Nanyue in preparation for the Banquet of Nations.

title: Me-Meeting the Parents!
overview: Yaoyao visits Chunyu's house after finding out that his mother is sick.

title: World Banquet!
overview: Yaoyao stays up all night preparing for the Banquet of Nations, ensuring that it is a success.

title: Cinderella Chef
overview: Finally, it's the day of the wedding!
